scope: Bounded interface comparison and synthetic CLI smoke only. The exact-duplicate selection interface binds text, ordered source refs, task scope, and caller-declared receiver-state revision; semantic necessity, actual receiver value, safe classification, real token/latency savings, and costs are not measured.
interface_findings: The receiver preflight validates receipt-to-bundle projection and receiver preconditions but does not choose advisory message IDs.
The context packet assembles caller-selected repository excerpts and structural obligation links; it does not select handoff advisories.
The reusable-context preflight checks caller-selected local derived cards; it does not edit or rank outgoing messages.
The context-packet comparator compares two built packets; it does not create an outgoing handoff message selection.
The new tool only proposes exact duplicate advisory omission and does not replace any comparator.
negative_controls: Same text with changed source refs retained.
Same content under another task scope retained.
Unknown or protected message kinds retained.
Duplicate JSON keys and oversized stdin rejected.
Same content under another receiver-state revision retained.
limits: Caller-declared context digests and receiver_state_ref are not authenticated or observed.
A caller can mislabel semantically important content as ADVISORY; the output is not auto-applied.
Content-byte count is not provider-token, latency, quality, or billing savings.
retirement_or_replacement: No existing tool retired or replaced; same-task outcome comparison remains unknown.

route_experiment.summary: Default route INCOMPLETE with no selected tools; explicit exact-ID allowlist yields COMPLETE for this single experimental tool; execution remains unauthorized and invocation was not performed.
